mentions.name: Voicecast
mentions.description: This app provides podcast voicemail and videomail, letting content creators collect audio and video messages from their audience; it is expanding to target the YouTuber and Twitch streamer market.
mentions.audience: Trying to capture the YouTuber and Twitch streamer market
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on https://voicecast.app/. It’s podcast voicemail and now recently, videomail. Trying to capture the YouTuber and Twitch streamer market but worried about diluting the product’s selling point.
